picks.title: Traverse City expands holiday festivities to two-day celebration
picks.desc: Traverse City is expanding its annual downtown holiday festivities into a two-day celebration this year, separating the traditional Christmas tree lighting and light parade across Friday and Saturday. The Traverse City Downtown Development Authority restructured the schedule following public feedback and discussions with the Traverse City Police Department to better manage crowds and improve safety downtown.
